dialog.string: Your favorite evoli evolution is : VOLTALI !!
You are an energetic and passionate person, much like Voltali.
You overflow with positive energy and enjoy being in the midst of
action.You're always ready to take on new challenges and push
yourself. Your enthusiasm is contagious, often inspiring others to
step out of their comfort zones. However, you may struggle to find
stillness, as you are constantly seeking new experiences and stimulation.
